summary: Seagate Technology Holdings plc filed an 8-K after its subsidiary Seagate HDD Cayman completed the call of all outstanding 3.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2028. On the September 8, 2026 redemption date, roughly $150.7 million was redeemed at par plus accrued interest; notes submitted by the September 3 deadline were exchanged, with principal paid in cash and excess value settled via 1,647,862 newly issued ordinary shares ($150.51 million notional) plus cash in lieu of fractions. Approximately $150.97 million cash was paid. The debt reduction eliminates exchangeable overhang; potential future share resale is the watch item.
